sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.notes: Foundational Transformer paper; predates current chat post-training, long-context, and serving practice and is not product-behavior evidence.

sources.title: SentencePiece: A simple and language independent subword tokenizer and detokenizer for Neural Text Processing
sources.notes: One tokenizer family; consequences depend on the model's actual training tokenizer and template.

sources.title: Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with Subword Units
sources.notes: Early machine-translation BPE study; not a universal tokenizer prescription or product-quality result.

sources.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
sources.notes: One model family and post-training pipeline; human preference is not identical to truth, safety, or task success.

sources.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
sources.notes: Empirical relationships for studied pretraining regimes; not task-specific model or deployment-posture evidence.

sources.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
sources.notes: Pretraining research that revised compute-allocation evidence; not direct product-selection or post-training fitness evidence.

sources.title: Model optimization
sources.notes: Provider-specific living guidance used for its evaluate-improve loop, not API permanence or universal process authority.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.notes: Voluntary cross-sector guidance; not proof of compliance, safety, or formal approval for Mosaic Desk.

sources.title: Holistic Evaluation of Language Models
sources.notes: Broad benchmark framework whose scenarios and models age; task-specific product release evidence remains necessary.

sources.title: Working with evals
sources.notes: Provider-specific evaluation implementation; datasets and regression loops are expressed provider-neutrally in this book.

sources.title: Define success criteria and build evaluations
sources.notes: Provider guidance; criteria and evaluation methods need consequence-specific validation and cannot prove complete coverage.

sources.title: Prompt design strategies
sources.notes: Model-family-specific recommendations and examples change; all require representative evaluation.

sources.title: Structured outputs
sources.notes: Schema support and supported subset depend on API/model; semantic correctness, provenance, and authorization still require validation.

sources.title: Text generation strategies
sources.notes: Versioned library guidance; decoding strategies and defaults do not guarantee task quality or stable behavior across releases.

sources.title: Writing a chat template
sources.notes: Implementation guide; the correct template is model-specific and must match training format.

sources.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
sources.notes: Position findings vary by task and model; current candidates require fresh testing and the paper is not a universal ordering rule.

sources.title: More than you've asked for: A Comprehensive Analysis of Novel Prompt Injection Threats to Application-Integrated Large Language Models
sources.notes: Foundational prompt-injection study; attack/defense behavior evolves and no universal exploitability or complete defense is established.

sources.title: Adversarial Machine Learning: A Taxonomy and Terminology of Attacks and Mitigations
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.notes: Taxonomy and guidance; listed mitigations are not proof of sufficiency for a specific system.

sources.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
sources.notes: Original RAG formulation and benchmark setup; reported results do not transfer automatically to current stacks or Mosaic Desk.

sources.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
sources.notes: Open-domain QA benchmark evidence; target corpora, permissions, freshness, domain shift, and current implementations require separate evaluation.

sources.title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks
sources.notes: Specific embedding architecture and tasks; quality must be evaluated on the authorized target corpus and query distribution.

sources.title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT
sources.notes: Reported effectiveness and efficiency are benchmark, implementation, and hardware dependent; not a universal retrieval winner.

sources.title: Precise Zero-Shot Dense Retrieval without Relevance Labels
sources.notes: HyDE's hypothetical documents can import generator assumptions and costs; target evaluation is mandatory and synthetic text is not evidence.

sources.title: BEIR: A Heterogeneous Benchmark for Zero-shot Evaluation of Information Retrieval Models
sources.notes: Benchmark diversity is not a substitute for Mosaic's authorized corpus, permissions, case mix, relevance labels, or workload evidence.

sources.title: RAGAS: Automated Evaluation of Retrieval Augmented Generation
sources.notes: Automated RAG metrics and evaluator models require calibration; metric labels do not prove ground truth or authority.

sources.title: Citations
sources.notes: Provider feature and reported evaluation; citation formatting does not establish source truth, permission, applicability, entailment, or authority.

sources.title: Evaluate a judge model
sources.notes: Managed preview implementation details are volatile, and agreement with human ratings remains judge-, criterion-, population-, and task-specific.

sources.title: Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena
sources.notes: Reported agreement and bias results are judge-, task-, and setup-specific; human preference is not identical to factual correctness or domain authority.

sources.title: G-Eval: NLG Evaluation using GPT-4 with Better Human Alignment
sources.notes: Results cover selected NLG tasks and a specific evaluator family; they do not establish evaluator independence, current-model behavior, or domain authority.

sources.title: RewardBench: Evaluating Reward Models for Language Modeling
sources.notes: Evidence is bounded to the benchmark and studied reward-model population; leaderboard performance is not a product release decision.

sources.title: 2024 NIST GenAI Pilot Study: Text-to-Text Evaluation Overview and Results
authors: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.notes: A pilot task and report, not evidence for universal metrics, target-case representativeness, or certification thresholds.

sources.title: Demystifying evals for AI agents
sources.notes: Agent-oriented official engineering guidance; this chapter uses only transferable trial-design principles, not agent outcomes or a universal trial count.

sources.title: Graders
sources.notes: Provider-specific grader implementation; correctness, independence, calibration, and fitness for a consequence remain the system owner's burden.

sources.title: Dolma: an Open Corpus of Three Trillion Tokens for Language Model Pretraining Research
sources.notes: A documented pretraining corpus pipeline at scale; task-specific evaluation representativeness, data rights, and local adequacy remain different questions.

sources.title: Deduplicating Training Data Makes Language Models Better
sources.notes: Findings depend on corpus, model, and training regime; similarity thresholds can also remove legitimate repetition and do not prove an evaluation split is clean.

sources.title: Datasheets for Datasets
sources.notes: Documentation improves scrutiny but is not proof that data are representative, lawful, safe, or sufficient for a particular consequence.

sources.title: Aya Model: An Instruction Finetuned Open-Access Multilingual Language Model
sources.notes: Reported multilingual coverage and results do not establish equal capability across languages or transfer to Mosaic Desk.

sources.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
sources.notes: One adaptation method showing a weight-access control surface; reported efficiency and quality are model/task dependent and do not select a Mosaic posture.

sources.title: Model Cards for Model Reporting
sources.notes: Documentation improves transparency but does not establish fitness, safety, compatibility, or approval by itself.

sources.title: Latency optimization
sources.notes: Provider-specific guidance and cost model; end-to-end latency tails require measurement on the target workload.

sources.title: Deprecations
sources.notes: One provider's current lifecycle; schedules and replacement guidance change and do not establish replacement equivalence.

sources.title: Safety best practices
sources.notes: Provider guidance and tools do not establish sufficient controls, reviewer capacity, or approval for a specific consequence.

sources.title: Prompt caching
sources.notes: Provider-specific caching semantics and eligibility; savings depend on request shape, authorization design, and current pricing.
